items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] One of the things that Jesse [phonetic sp.] wanted me to ask you about...

ctx.x: And I hate to, you know, I hate to say that, but it is. People would just face up to the reality and then say "That's life", but we have to remember that now and, you know, bend. But. Yeah. [laughs]

One of the things that Jesse [phonetic sp.] wanted me to ask you about was the different singers that you've worked with over the years. Now, I know you had a very close relationship with Babs Gonzales [phonetic sp.] for a while? And then also Eddie Jefferson, worked with Dinah Washington, Ella Fitzgerald, all of these wonderful singers, and you're a wonderful singer yourself.
